fieldData.description: To celebrate the 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come spend time with the Italians at the beach at Forte dei Marmi or indulge in their metaverse space for an online meetup experience! Make sure to join and have a great time talking about Crypto and RadixDLT. Did we mention there’s also free food and drinks at the beach?? For any questions, DM @YleniaMNG or @Michelinux on Telegram
fieldData.location: Via Arenile, 52 52 Via Arenile 55042 Forte dei Marmi Italy
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - Forte dei Marmi, Italy
